title: CI: the moto image pull hits the Docker Hub anonymous rate limit and fails the conversation job
description: Develop CI failed on three consecutive runs (2026-10-09, board and docs commits) in the conversation job: 'toomanyrequests: You have reached your unauthenticated pull rate limit' while pulling motoserver/moto:5.2.3. Not a code failure. Options: authenticate the pull (docker login with a Docker Hub token in a repo secret), or mirror the image to GHCR and pull it with GITHUB_TOKEN, or cache the image layer in the workflow. Prefer the GHCR mirror (no new third-party secret). Check the PR workflow too: rerun when it hits.
right_now_summary: The conversation job still fails when Docker Hub rate-limits the unauthenticated Moto image pull.
